thread:
clara: Heads-up: pipeline #3490 failed during 'download-shards' on staging and deploybot paused the promotion. Artifacts appear to have mismatched shard manifests.

deploy-bot: Promotion paused for commit zyx321cba due to 'download-shards' failure on runner staging-03. Error: shard manifest mismatch (manifest v1 lists 7 parts, found 6). Auto-retries exhausted (3/3).

mike: that's odd. Could be a cancelled multipart upload or a stale index. Any artifact storage logs?

clara: quick job log:
```
Verifying shards for artifacts.tar.gz
Expected parts: 7
Found parts: 6
Error: missing part 4
```

hana: missing part -> truncated upload or metadata race. If it was truncated the canonical bucket might still have a complete copy from the builder cache. Options: 1) reassemble from builder cache and reupload; 2) trigger a reprovision and fresh build (slower); 3) pin release to last good (v1.6.4) for this change window.

mike: what's ETA on a clean build? We have ~50m left in the window. Fresh build ~25-30m, reupload from cache ~10m. Given risk, reupload is preferred.

clara: builder cache location /var/build/cache/3490/artifacts_shards/. I'll try to reassemble part 4 and push to s3 with verified manifest. Posting exact commands for audit:
```
cd /var/build/cache/3490/artifacts_shards/
cat part-{1..7} > artifacts.tar.gz
sha256sum artifacts.tar.gz > artifacts.sha256
aws s3 cp artifacts.tar.gz s3://ci-release/artifacts/zyx321cba/artifacts.tar.gz --acl private
aws s3 cp artifacts.sha256 s3://ci-release/artifacts/zyx321cba/artifacts.sha256
# update manifest
aws s3 cp manifest.json s3://ci-release/artifacts/zyx321cba/manifest.json --acl private
```

hana: thanks. please ensure you lock write access while we retry. Also ping @infra-oncall in case any multipart aborts to be checked.

infra-oncall: on it. I'll scan the S3 multipart logs for aborts around the build time and report back.

clara: reuploading part 4 now and pushing updated manifest. Then I'll kick a manual retry: `deploybot retry 3490 --by clara --reason \"reupload missing shard\"`.

deploy-bot: Manual retry requested by clara for pipeline 3490. Queued on runner staging-08.

(7m later)

deploy-bot: Pipeline 3490 retry completed with exit code 0. download-shards PASS after reupload. Canaries remain paused pending quick integration smoke.

mike: starting quick integration smoke: run auth, db migrations dry-run, and the end-to-end checkout flow 5x.

(12m later)
mike: smoke results: auth ok, migrations dry-run ok, e2e checkout flow passed 5/5. No regressions observed.

infra-oncall: S3 logs show a multipart upload abort for the object path during the initial build window. Root cause: intermittent proxy timeout between builder pool and S3 in us-east-2. Filed INFRA-2350; assigning to networking. No other aborts detected.

hana: given successful reupload and clean smoke, decision: proceed with canary promote but keep the release pinned for immediate rollback if we see artifact-related 5xx or file missing errors. If we see repeats, we revert to v1.6.4 and halt further promotions.

clara: promoting canary in 5m and monitoring. I'll also add an entry in release notes: \"Artifact shard reupload and manifest fix; smoke tests passed; monitoring for multipart aborts (INFRA-2350).\"

(20m later)

deploy-bot: Canary promotion completed. Release continued.

mike: monitoring logs and storage metrics; no anomalies so far.

hana: thanks team. Closing thread for this change window; follow-up on INFRA-2350 tomorrow.
